newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral plugs, abandons Chandler#4.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral plugs, abandons Chandler#4.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said Tuesday it plugged and abandoned its Chandler #4 well after analysis indicated that the objective sands reached in the drilling were wet.
The company, which owns a 100 percent working interest in the development well, said the well was drilled to a depth of 9,000 feet at its Yoakum field in Lavaca County, Texas.
Its Klekar #1 gas well tested 1,400,000 cubic feet of gas and 180 barrels of condensate per day, it said.
The well was placed on production on February 8 and is currently producing at a sustained rate of 900,000 cubic feet of gas and 100 barrels of condensate a day, it said.
It said the well, in which it owns a 45 percent working interest, is located in Hallettsville field in Lavaca County and is operated by the company.
